关于docker pull 超时的问题，我的有效的解决方案：
```bash
sudo vi /etc/docker/daemon.json
```

配置如下：

```json
{
    "runtimes": {
        "nvidia": {
            "path": "nvidia-container-runtime",
            "runtimeArgs": []
        }
    },
    "data-root": "/mnt/docker",
    "registry-mirrors": [
                "https://registry.docker-cn.com",
        "https://mirrors.tuna.tsinghua.edu.cn/",
            "https://docker.registry.cyou",
        "https://docker-cf.registry.cyou",
        "https://dockercf.jsdelivr.fyi",
        "https://docker.jsdelivr.fyi",

}
```

# Hfmirror国内镜像下载大模型的数据及代码

download_data.sh
```sh
#pip install -U huggingface_hub
export HF_ENDPOINT=https://hf-mirror.com

data_online_path="ystemsrx/Erotic_Literature_Collection"
local_path="ystemsrx/Erotic_Literature_Collection"

huggingface-cli download \
--token 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 \
--repo-type dataset \
--resume-download $data_online_path  \
--local-dir $local_path \
--local-dir-use-symlinks False
```

download_model.sh
```sh
export HF_ENDPOINT=https://hf-mirror.com

model_online_path="BAAI/Bunny-v1_0-4B-gguf"
local_path="BAAI/Bunny-v1_0-4B-gguf"

huggingface-cli download \
--token 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 \
--resume-download $model_online_path  \
--local-dir $local_path \
--local-dir-use-symlinks False \
--exclude *.onnx *.ot *.h5 *.msgpack ggml-model-f16.gguf
# --max-workers 32 
```
